notes: Single source of truth for every plaque option. The parser, the UI, the image prompts and both PDFs read this file. To add an option: add an entry here and drop its icon into the 'asset' path.

materials.label: Cast Bronze
materials.prompt: solid cast bronze, sand-cast then machined, with crisp raised detail

materials.label: Cast Aluminum
materials.prompt: solid cast aluminum with crisp raised detail

finishes.label: Natural Satin Brushed Bronze
finishes.prompt: natural satin brushed bronze: warm golden-tan bronze with a fine straight-line brushed grain, soft low-glare sheen, no mirror reflections

finishes.label: Chemical Oxidized
finishes.prompt: chemically oxidized bronze: deep chocolate-brown oxidized bronze with brighter hand-relieved highlights on the raised high points

finishes.label: Verde Patina
finishes.prompt: verde patina: mottled sage-to-deep green chemical patina over bronze, with bronze showing through on worn raised edges

finishes.label: Turquoise Patina
finishes.prompt: turquoise patina: mottled blue-green turquoise chemical patina over bronze, bronze showing on the raised edges

finishes.label: Light Oxidized (tint)
finishes.prompt: light oxidized bronze tint: satin bronze with a light warm brown tint that slightly darkens the metal

finishes.label: Medium Oxidized (tint)
finishes.prompt: medium oxidized bronze tint: satin bronze toned to a medium antique brown

finishes.label: Dark Oxidized (tint)
finishes.prompt: dark oxidized bronze tint: satin bronze toned to a dark statuary brown, raised faces still readable as metal

finishes.label: Polished
finishes.prompt: polished bronze: raised faces buffed to a bright mirror-like gold bronze with crisp specular highlights

finishes.label: Brushed Aluminum
finishes.prompt: brushed aluminum: cool silver-grey aluminum with a fine straight-line brushed grain and soft satin sheen

backgroundColors.label: Dark Oxide
backgroundColors.prompt: dark oxide paint: a near-black warm charcoal-brown baked paint

backgroundColors.label: Black
backgroundColors.prompt: black paint: a true flat black baked paint

backgroundColors.label: Brown
backgroundColors.prompt: brown paint: a deep chocolate brown baked paint

backgroundColors.label: Duranodic Bronze
backgroundColors.prompt: duranodic bronze paint: a dark architectural bronze-brown baked paint

backgroundTextures.label: Leatherette
backgroundTextures.prompt: leatherette texture: a fine, irregular pebbled leather-grain texture cast into the recessed field

backgroundTextures.label: Stipple
backgroundTextures.prompt: stipple texture: a very fine uniform sand-like stipple cast into the recessed field

backgroundTextures.label: Pebble
backgroundTextures.prompt: pebble texture: a coarser rounded pebble grain cast into the recessed field

backgroundTextures.label: Smooth
backgroundTextures.prompt: smooth: no texture, a flat, even painted surface

borders.label: Single Line Border
borders.prompt: a single raised flat border band about 1/4 inch wide running around the plaque edge

borders.label: No Border
borders.prompt: no border: the recessed textured field runs right up to the plaque edge

borders.label: Double Line Border
borders.prompt: a double line border: a raised flat band at the plaque edge, a narrow recessed gap, then a thinner raised inner line

scaling.note: Measured: 7x5 (Structure of Merit outline art) 0.15/0.05/0.10 in; 12x16 (Camp Southern Ground proof) 0.28/0.12/0.13 in. Grows linearly with the plaque's shorter side.

borders.label: Bevel Edge Border
borders.prompt: a bevel edge border: the plaque edge is a raised band about 3/8 inch wide that slopes down from the face toward the outer edge, catching light along the bevel

fonts.label: Times New Roman
fonts.prompt: Times New Roman, a classic transitional serif

fonts.label: Franklin
fonts.prompt: Franklin Gothic, a sturdy grotesque sans-serif

imageOptions.label: Photo Relief
imageOptions.prompt: PHOTO RELIEF: the supplied photo is reproduced as a shallow photographic relief cast into the metal. It reads as a monotone image in the plaque's metal color: highlights are bright raised metal, shadows are darker recessed metal. It keeps photographic detail and likeness but is clearly metal, not paper, with no color other than the metal and its darkened tones.

imageOptions.label: Bas Relief
imageOptions.prompt: BAS RELIEF: the subject is hand-sculpted and cast as a raised three-dimensional bas-relief in solid metal, like a sculpted medallion portrait. Real depth with soft modeled forms, cast shadows from the raised forms, no photographic tones, no printed image. Same metal and finish as the plaque.

imageOptions.label: Etched Photo
imageOptions.prompt: ETCHED PHOTO: the photo is chemically etched into a flat panel set into the plaque. It appears as a flat, crisp dark-toned photographic image on the panel surface (no sculpted depth), like a fine halftone etched and darkened into metal.

imageOptions.label: Full Color UV Printed
imageOptions.prompt: FULL COLOR UV PRINT: the supplied photo is printed in full natural color directly on a flat panel set into the plaque, sharp and true to the original photo, with a slight satin clear-coat sheen. Flat, no relief.

mountings.label: Blind Mount
mountings.prompt: blind mounted with hidden studs on the back, so no fasteners are visible on the face

mountings.label: Countersunk Screws
mountings.prompt: mounted with screws through the face, small screw heads visible in each corner within the border

mountings.label: Decorative Rosettes
mountings.prompt: mounted with small decorative bronze rosette caps covering the screws in each corner within the border

mountings.label: Garden Stake
mountings.prompt: mounted on a garden stake from the back, so no fasteners are visible on the face

lettering.label: Raised
lettering.prompt: raised lettering in the same metal and finish as the plate, with crisp vertical sides

coating: Protective clear polyurethane coating for outdoor durability.

proof.disclaimer: Simulated appearance, actual product finish may vary. Effects for illustrative purposes only

processes.label: Cast
processes.prompt: sand-cast bronze: raised elements stand clearly proud of the recessed field (about 1/16 inch), with slightly softened cast edges

processes.label: Reverse Etched
processes.prompt: reverse-etched bronze: a flat machined bronze plate where the background is chemically etched away, leaving very shallow, razor-crisp, flat-faced letters and border; the etched background is paint-filled; overall flatter and sharper than a casting

proofStyles.label: Standard proof
proofStyles.description: The Liquid Mercury layout: plaque with red dimension brackets, mounting diagram, finish and paint-fill swatches.

proofStyles.label: Description sheet
proofStyles.description: Order description header, blue dimension arrows, captioned option tiles and a Visual Scale figure (like the Awe and Raccoon River proofs).

proofStyles.label: Order version + outline art
proofStyles.description: "ORDER # – VERSION" header, side-view mounting, process captions, plus a second page with the outline art for production (like Structure of Merit).
